CardDescription.DefaultText: The bones fall in a heap, heavy end down. Within a day of this casting the black bear is hungry again, and from then on, while autumn lasts, it may raid the food kept in your containers and stores whenever you are outside. The eagle cannot come within a day of this casting.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Pick the bones up and put them away.
